verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official MCP server that brings its behavioral data into AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and OpenAI, so an agent can answer product and growth questions without SQL. A probe confirms the MCP server page exists. The Dashboard REST API returns chart data as JSON, and further APIs cover event export, cohorts and an OpenAPI spec, giving agents programmatic query paths. Missing for 10: detailed MCP tool and query documentation (marketing-level claims only), an explicit ad-hoc query API beyond dashboard and chart data retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent querying.
